subject.title: [Feature]: Let plugin tool results request a clean turn yield

question: Should the public Plugin SDK adopt an additive result-level yield control as the canonical way for a successful plugin tool to hand off to a later externally correlated turn?
rationale: This creates a durable public plugin contract and selects ownership between declarative tool results, imperative tool context, and the broader structured-interaction roadmap; automation cannot choose that API direction safely.

options.title: Approve Result Control
options.body: Adopt the additive result-level control, require normal result persistence before yielding, and specify explicit behavior for every supported runtime.

options.title: Use Context Method
options.body: Expose an imperative plugin context method instead, accepting the additional ordering and atomicity rules needed around result persistence.

options.title: Defer To Interaction Pipeline
options.body: Keep the SDK unchanged until the broader structured-question pipeline defines a unified external-interaction lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Approve Result Control
recommendation.body: Adopt the additive result-level control, require normal result persistence before yielding, and specify explicit behavior for every supported runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work directly touched yielded completion and the runner lifecycle where this contract would terminate the turn.
